name: Paragominas (Brazil)
description: White field charged with the municipal emblem: a torch with a red and yellow flame over three hexagons reading PARA, GO and MINAS, with green and blue bands rising to the upper corners.
history: Paragominas is a municipality in the state of Pará, Brazil.
